'''Idrig Eeba''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] affiliated with the [[Exchange]]. Eeba vowed to take revenge against the criminal [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] for every time he had double-crossed the Exchange.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
